dogecoin.text: @MarioNawfal Hold up, let's not get too carried away with the everybody wants Bitcoin hype. I've seen more people invested in Dogecoin at my local sports bar than actual financial institutions. Priorities, folks!

@bennyjohnson Love the enthusiasm, but let's keep things in perspective - the guy just made a fortune off dogecoin, that doesn't mean he didn't get any government help. Not saying it's a bad thing, just be honest about it, right?..weird

@freedomcaucus Let's hope they follow through on this, a good start is better than nothing. But at the end of the day, cutting DOGE (dogecoin) spending isn't exactly a huge achievement when we're still not addressing the root issues. What about getting back to 2018 levels, or even better, 2000?
